base_url.description: Base URL of the Bahmni OpenMRS instance, e.g. http://localhost/openmrs for a local Bahmni/bahmni-docker deployment.

username.description: OpenMRS username for HTTP Basic authentication.

password.description: OpenMRS password for HTTP Basic authentication; never logged or printed.

patient_query.description: Required identifier or name search term for the patients stream; OpenMRS REST does not support unqualified patient get-all in the pinned STANDARD alpha stack.

patient_uuid.description: Required patient UUID context used to scope patient-linked streams that require patientUuid/patient query parameters (encounters, observations, visits, orders, lab results, diagnoses).

appointment_date.description: Required appointment day scope formatted exactly as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSS for appointments 2.0.2 forDate parsing; patient_uuid does not scope this route.

lab_result_concepts.description: Required comma-separated Bahmni concept names for lab_results; BahmniObservationsController 1.2.1 requires at least one concept query value.
